meta.notes: Orders come from view_reports.oms_sales_union, the table the business uses for its own sales reporting. Filters match the canonical query exactly: date window only, no status or validity filters, no deduplication (SUM(sales) on this table matches per-order aggregation, so there is no row duplication to remove). Set METRICS_PERIOD_ANCHOR=month so the window is the last 6 COMPLETE calendar months, reproducing `date >= '2026-03-01' AND date < '2026-09-01'`. aovMethod is 'average_of_rows' to reproduce the canonical AVG(sales) query -- note this is the average LINE ITEM value (1.75 rows per order), not the average order value, and reads 35-55% lower than SUM(sales)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id). Switch to 'total_over_orders' for true AOV. The previous mapping against view_reports.oms_sales_raw_optimized is kept as config/schema.mapping.oms-raw.json.
